verdict.rationale: Stripe's public pricing page confirms agent-originated orders ride the same disclosed flat rates (2.9%+30¢ plus published adders) with 'no separate agentic-channel fee schedule disclosed,' letting a merchant estimate costs without a sales call. However, community discussion around ChatGPT's ACP integration references an additional 'small fee' merchants pay on completed purchases that isn't itemized in Stripe's own pricing docs, leaving ambiguity about whether OCA/ACP flows carry extra platform costs beyond standard card rates. Missing for 10: an explicit dedicated line-item for agentic-channel fees, clarification on any ACP/OCA platform surcharge, and reconciliation of the 'small fee' mentioned in community sources with Stripe's published rate card.
